address: Nanjichang Night Market, Stall 74, Lane 311, Section 2, Zhonghua Road, Zhongzheng District, Taipei, Taiwan
bio: This pushcart near the end of the market may lack a sign but it always attracts a queue. Their shaobing, fried in oil then baked in a clay oven, comes in two sweet and two savoury varieties – try the minced pork or sugar filling.
